title: Saudi Leader Meets U.S. Commander as Houthi Attacks Threaten Oil Markets
summary: Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman asked the United States for more U.S. military help last week after the Iranian-backed Houthi forces in Yemen launched a broad offensive.
